sql: with o as (select market_ticker, strategy, status, sum(quantity) as qty, max(limit_price) as px from live_orders where strategy in ('Nmmsell10','Kmmsell10') and created_at >= '2026-10-16 14:11' group by 1,2,3), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl, coalesce(quantity_fp,quantity) as pos from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), tw as (select market_ticker, count(*) as twin_rows, sum(pnl) as twin_pnl, string_agg(distinct status, ',') as twin_status from paper_trades where strategy='Nmmsell10_pt4' group by 1) select o.strategy, o.market_ticker, o.status, o.qty, o.px, p.pos, p.realized_pnl as acct_realized, tw.twin_rows, tw.twin_status, tw.twin_pnl from o left join p using (market_ticker) left join tw using (market_ticker) where o.strategy='Nmmsell10' or o.market_ticker in (select market_ticker from o where strategy='Nmmsell10') order by o.market_ticker, o.strategy
